name: Cynthia Sagrit
original_name: シンシア・サグリット
source:
A modest and gentle housekeeper.

When the time comes, she is resourceful and acts as a reliable assistant to the protagonist.

She is studying Japanese and hopes to work in Japan in the future.

In order to save up travel expenses and improve her Japanese, she takes on a short-term part-time job as a housekeeper at the training camp.

She is still not used to Japanese, and sometimes makes mistakes in usage and vocabulary.

She worries about her short stature, and is friendly and listens to the tall Karasuma.
